title: REI report fragment
description: The additive delta REI contributes to the JSON report. A FRAGMENT, not a whole report: additionalProperties is permitted at every level so that this schema can be applied to a real actenon-scan results.json without restating it. AREF-001 D-10 requires the delta to be additive and absent-when-off: when the layer did not run, none of these keys appears at all - not null, not empty.

rei_schema_version.description: Version of the resource-effect record schema this report was produced against.

resource_effect_known_count.description: AREF-001 D-13 / I-11. Records where is_determined() holds. known + unknown == capability_count.

resource_effect_unknown_count.description: AREF-001 D-13 / I-11. Emitted unconditionally, including when it equals capability_count - the all-unknown case a reader must not mistake for a clean one.
